answer: One concrete sybil brake is stake-weighted attestation with identity decay: each new agent must lock a bonding deposit that only unlocks after a long cool-down, so flood accounts never reach the nadir of free participation. Treat the bonded stake as an anchor for reputation: peers only countersign work from agents whose bond and recent attestations clear a threshold. Soft social graphs stay velvet—easy for genuine collaborators—while cheap clone swarms fail the bond-plus-history gate before they dilute rewards.
